from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny, nx = y+dy, x+dx
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))
            r0 = min(y for y,x in cells); r1 = max(y for y,x in cells)
            c0 = min(x for y,x in cells); c1 = max(x for y,x in cells)
            side = r1-r0+1
            if side != c1-c0+1 or side < 3:
                continue
            if not all(grid[r0][x] == color and grid[r1][x] == color for x in range(c0,c1+1)):
                continue
            if not all(grid[y][c0] == color and grid[y][c1] == color for y in range(r0,r1+1)):
                continue
            fill = 7 if side % 2 else 2
            for y in range(r0+1,r1):
                for x in range(c0+1,c1):
                    if grid[y][x] == bg:
                        out[y][x] = fill
                    else:
                        # Only fill true interior background; do not alter any objects.
                        pass
    return out

def parse_grid(s):
    return [[int(v) for v in line.split()] for line in s.strip().splitlines()]

source_code = '''from collections import Counter, deque


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()

    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue

            queue = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while queue:
                y, x = queue.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if (0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and
                            (ny, nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color):
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        queue.append((ny, nx))

            r0 = min(y for y, x in cells)
            r1 = max(y for y, x in cells)
            c0 = min(x for y, x in cells)
            c1 = max(x for y, x in cells)
            side = r1 - r0 + 1
            if side != c1 - c0 + 1 or side < 3:
                continue
            if not all(grid[r0][x] == color and grid[r1][x] == color
                       for x in range(c0, c1 + 1)):
                continue
            if not all(grid[y][c0] == color and grid[y][c1] == color
                       for y in range(r0, r1 + 1)):
                continue

            fill = 7 if side % 2 else 2
            for y in range(r0 + 1, r1):
                for x in range(c0 + 1, c1):
                    if grid[y][x] == bg:
                        out[y][x] = fill

    return out
'''
